An '''Imperial embassy''' was the diplomatic mission of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to the [[Kingdom of Devit]] and was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lazerian IV]]. It was staffed by an [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]], as well as their eight staff. Fourteen members of the [[King's Own Guard]], as well as thirty-six [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], were also stationed at the embassy.<ref name="TSoK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial embassy was created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
